label: Liaoyang: Liaoyang whole in the Anshan-Liaoyang metro
why: Liaoyang County (lbk, 0.47M plan, under China's 1M floor) is a zone of its own wrapped round Liaoyang city, 4th worst worldwide (hull 0.52, 56% of its commutes cross its line). Liaoyang's centre (Baita, Hongwei) is already in Anshan's metro (ans), where most of lbk's commutes go (86,000 a day), while three more Liaoyang city districts (Wensheng, Taizihe, Gongchangling) and Dengta sit in Benxi's zone (pns), a finger between them. lbk is retired into ans and the four join it, so all of Liaoyang prefecture is one zone with Anshan; ans's FUAs for pop_vs_fua add Liaoyang's, Gongchangling's and Dengta's (GHS-FUA 8769, 8865, 8767), though the check is relaxed for Chinese metros (T-897). Benxi's zone (pns, shown as Benxi) keeps Benxi's four districts and takes Benxi County from Shuncheng's zone (scn, Fushun): with Dengta left in it its hull falls to 0.63, and without Benxi County scn would wrap it.
